card.name: "caused by" before the JC virus
card.fires_on: The word "by" in "caused by the JC virus" in PML warnings for multiple sclerosis drugs. Also "including" before a list of birth defects, and a shell prompt "#" before a command.

modes.label: PML cause phrase
modes.description: "by" right after "opportunistic viral infection of the brain caused", leading into the JC virus.
modes.example: PML is an opportunistic viral infection of the brain caused<< by>> the JC virus (JCV) that

modes.label: Birth defect list
modes.description: "including" after facial abnormalities, introducing cleft lip and palate.
modes.example: especially external ear and other facial abnormalities<< including>> cleft lip and palate, and anomalies

modes.label: Shell prompt
modes.description: A root shell prompt symbol before a Linux command.
modes.example: # id -Z Or to view the security context associated with a file: <<#>> ls -lZ /var/www/html

card.writes: It suppresses "search" words and slightly promotes "stat" words, with no clear link to the contexts.
card.plain: It fires on the "by" in "caused by the JC virus" in PML warnings, and a few similar spots.
